fact: ITWeb Africa reports on 31 January 2025 that the Central African Republic's director general of taxes said the e-tax system's registration and e-filing modules were fully operational, with the platform allowing electronic tax filing and payment.
The IMF notes the Central African authorities adopted the integrated financial information system at the treasury directorate and in line ministries.
The tax directorate (DGID) began its official switch in April 2025 to general use of the e-Tax electronic declaration system, after customs in 2024.
